_note: Model IDs rot. The arrays below were read back from each vendor's GET /models with a real key, or from their docs where marked. They are dropdown hints, not a contract: click 拉取 to ask the endpoint what this key can call today.

deepseek.label: DeepSeek
deepseek.note: Chat only, no embeddings. deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner were retired on 2026-07-24.

zhipu.label: Zhipu GLM
zhipu.note: The /models route returns chat models only; embedding-3 does not appear in it. Keep the built-in name for vectors.

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.note: Docs are behind Cloudflare. Fetch the list with your key, or type the model name.

siliconflow.label: SiliconFlow
siliconflow.note: Model IDs are host-specific. Fetch the list with your key, or type the model name.

ollama.label: Ollama (local)
ollama.note: Whatever you pulled with `ollama pull`. Fetch lists what is installed locally.

custom.label: Custom endpoint
custom.note: Any OpenAI-compatible server. Model name is required.
